title: Exploding variance of means of exponentials: least-squares to the rescue
summary: Francis Bach discusses the 'exploding variance' problem that occurs when computing means of exponential functions in statistical learning, and presents least-squares spectral methods as a solution for stable log density estimation.
problem_solved: Addresses the numerical instability and variance explosion that occurs when computing expectations of exponential functions in statistical computations.
why_valuable: Provides a theoretically grounded solution to a fundamental numerical problem that affects many statistical and machine learning algorithms, improving both stability and accuracy.
